# Copilot instructions

Repository Purpose
This repository is a structured IT Knowledge Base containing:

Real-world troubleshooting cases
Infrastructure implementations
Cloud engineering notes
DevOps projects
Microsoft 365 administration
Networking and Active Directory documentation

## Documentation Rules
When creating documentation:

Place content in the most relevant category.
Create README.md files for every major folder.
Use Markdown only.
Use descriptive filenames with hyphens.
Prefer real-world examples and production scenarios.

## Repository purpose
This repository is a practical knowledge base documenting real-world troubleshooting scenarios, technical solutions, infrastructure configurations, automation scripts, and lessons learned across cloud engineering, DevOps, cybersecurity, networking, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Linux, and systems administration.

## Content conventions
Follow conventions established by existing cases as the repository grows. Keep new documentation grounded in the actual scenario, solution, and lessons learned; do not assume a case template that is not present in the repository.
